## 4.1.48 (HexGhoul): the circus tent and its Clowns; Ayato and Noro on slim arms, builds evened out

HexKagune 4.1.48 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (121). **Try it in a NEW world** (old chunks never get the tent).

Your words: "Ayato and Noro should both be Alex models", "ayato is meant to have muscles they're gone? Also give some to Noro, both less
than the player, noro more than ayato", then "Reduce the player's muscle size to be the same as Noro." The circus: your
`circus.schematic`, your choices "One per world + clowns" and "Yes, rivals".

**The circus tent:**
- Your tent, block for block (red and white wool, the glowstone lamps, the spruce-framed arch, the grass tufts and the dandelion), **one
  per world**, on dry land in any biome, like the mansion. `/kagune places` lists it ("the Clowns' circus tent"); `/locate structure
  hexkagune:circus` finds it.
- It had no floor (it stood on your world's ground), so a **floor of dirt path** is laid under everything inside its ring: you walk in on
  it, and no tree or grass grows up inside. The ground round it is eased to it as for the other places.
- **Four Clowns live inside**, each in a different clown mask, all one gang: they start nothing, and whoever hurts one has all of them on
  him. They never despawn and never leave at dawn; each strolls about its own spot in the tent and walks back after a chase.
- **The Clowns and the Gas Masks are rivals:** when one sees the other, they fight (the roaming gangs too).
- One entrance: the arched door on the south side (the handoff thought there were four; those were bulges in the wall).

**The builds:**
- Ayato and Noro are on the slim (Alex) arms. Noro's skin was painted for wide arms, so the game's copy has each arm narrowed by a column
  (your original file is untouched).
- Ayato's muscles back (0.42, they were lost under his jacket at 0.3), Noro more (0.52), and **the male player now the same as Noro (0.52,
  was 0.6)**, arms set in to match.
